verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library that runs wherever Python runs and loads data into destinations you choose, such as a local DuckDB. You can switch destinations without changing pipeline code and read datasets as Pandas frames or Arrow tables, so data is not locked into a proprietary store. However, nothing explicitly documents bulk-exporting everything to open file formats like Parquet or CSV, or exporting data off the dltHub managed infrastructure. missing for 10: documented bulk export to open file formats (Parquet/CSV/JSONL destination), an export/offboarding path from dltHub managed infra, independent corroboration of leaving without lock-in
